title: Can Pinnacle Blooms help my child transition from nonverbal to verbal communication?
metaTitle: Transitioning from Nonverbal to Verbal communication at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: With a collaborative approach, Pinnacle Blooms aids nonverbal children to take gradual steps towards verbal communication with various intervention strategies.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms, our Speech and ABA therapists often join forces to gradually encourage nonverbal children towards verbal communication. We employ a gamut of strategies including vocalizations, word initiation, sign language, Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS) or even assistive technology as per the child's readiness. Our goal is to make the journey from nonverbal to verbal communication fulfilling and successful.
